points.title: 贫困童年
points.description: 1935年1月8日，埃尔维斯·普雷斯利出生于密西西比州图珀洛的一个贫困家庭。他的双胞胎兄弟杰西·加伦·普雷斯利在出生时即夭折，这给家庭带来了巨大打击。埃尔维斯与单亲母亲格拉迪斯和父亲弗农生活在一起，经济状况十分拮据。1936年，图珀洛遭遇严重龙卷风，全家房屋被毁，被迫住在亲戚家中。这段贫困的童年经历对埃尔维斯后来的性格和音乐风格产生了深远影响，他从小就接触了福音音乐和蓝调音乐，这些音乐元素后来融入了他的摇滚乐中。
points.descriptionEn: Born on January 8, 1935, in Tupelo, Mississippi, Elvis Aaron Presley came from a poor family. His twin brother Jesse Garon Presley was stillborn, a tragedy that deeply affected the family. Elvis grew up with his mother Gladys and father Vernon in dire financial circumstances. In 1936, Tupelo was devastated by a tornado that destroyed the family's home, forcing them to live with relatives. This impoverished childhood profoundly shaped Elvis's character and musical style, exposing him to gospel and blues music that would later influence his rock and roll performances.

points.title: 少年时期
points.description: 1948年，埃尔维斯随全家迁往田纳西州孟菲斯，寻求更好的经济机会。在孟菲斯的青少年时期，埃尔维斯开始对音乐产生浓厚兴趣。他经常前往黑人社区的音乐商店，聆听蓝调、乡村和福音音乐。1953年高中毕业后，埃尔维斯开始在帕克兄弟卡车公司担任卡车司机，同时开始在孟菲斯的录音室尝试录制音乐。这一时期，他吸收了多种音乐风格，形成了自己独特的音乐品味，为他后来的音乐生涯奠定了基础。
points.descriptionEn: In 1948, Elvis moved with his family to Memphis, Tennessee, seeking better economic opportunities. During his adolescence in Memphis, Elvis developed a strong interest in music. He frequently visited black neighborhoods' music stores to listen to blues, country, and gospel music. After graduating from high school in 1953, Elvis worked as a truck driver for the Parker Brothers Trucking Company while beginning to record music at Memphis recording studios. During this period, he absorbed various musical styles, forming his unique musical taste that would lay the foundation for his future career.

points.title: 音乐崛起
points.description: 1954年7月5日，埃尔维斯在孟菲斯的太阳录音室录制了《That's All Right》，这首歌标志着他音乐生涯的开始。他的独特风格融合了乡村、蓝调和福音音乐，迅速引起了当地听众的注意。1955年，他与山姆·菲利普斯的太阳唱片公司签约，并开始在全国范围内巡演。1956年，他推出了首张同名专辑《Elvis Presley》，其中的单曲《Heartbreak Hotel》成为他的第一首全国性热门歌曲。这一时期，埃尔维斯在孟菲斯建立了自己的音乐风格，并开始在全国范围内获得巨大成功，成为摇滚乐的标志性人物。
points.descriptionEn: On July 5, 1954, Elvis recorded 'That's All Right' at Sun Studio in Memphis, marking the beginning of his musical career. His unique style blending country, blues, and gospel music quickly caught the attention of local listeners. In 1955, he signed with Sam Phillips' Sun Records and began touring nationwide. In 1956, he released his debut album 'Elvis Presley,' featuring the single 'Heartbreak Hotel,' which became his first national hit. During this period in Memphis, Elvis established his distinctive musical style and began achieving massive success across the country, becoming an iconic figure in rock and roll.

points.title: 军旅生涯
points.description: 1958年3月，埃尔维斯应征入伍，被派往德国巴伐利亚州的巴特瑙海姆。尽管他的音乐事业正处于巅峰，埃尔维斯还是选择履行公民义务。在德国期间，他与普里西拉·比尤利相遇，后者后来成为他的妻子。军旅生涯对埃尔维斯产生了深远影响，他开始更加成熟，并重新思考自己的音乐方向。尽管在德国期间，他的音乐活动有所减少，但他的唱片公司继续发行他的录音，使他保持了公众的关注。1960年3月，埃尔维斯退役返回美国，开始了他的电影事业。
points.descriptionEn: In March 1958, Elvis was drafted into the U.S. Army and stationed in Bad Nauheim, Bavaria, Germany. Despite his music career being at its peak, Elvis chose to fulfill his civic duty. During his time in Germany, he met Priscilla Beaulieu, who would later become his wife. His military service profoundly affected Elvis, causing him to mature and reconsider his musical direction. Although his musical activities decreased in Germany, his record company continued releasing his recordings, keeping him in the public eye. In March 1960, Elvis was honorably discharged and returned to the United States, beginning his film career.

points.title: 电影明星
points.description: 1960年退役后，埃尔维斯将事业重心转向好莱坞，在洛杉矶开始了他的电影生涯。他在1960年代拍摄了多部电影，如《蓝色夏威夷》、《女孩！女孩！女孩！》等，虽然这些电影商业上取得成功，但艺术价值有限。1967年5月1日，埃尔维斯与普里西拉在拉斯维加斯结婚，1968年2月9日，他们的女儿丽莎·玛丽出生。这一时期，埃尔维斯的音乐创作相对减少，主要专注于电影事业。然而，1968年的特别节目《埃尔维斯归来》标志着他音乐生涯的重要转折点，他重新回到录音室，开始创作更具深度的音乐作品。
points.descriptionEn: After his discharge in 1960, Elvis shifted his focus to Hollywood, beginning his film career in Los Angeles. Throughout the 1960s, he starred in numerous films such as 'Blue Hawaii' and 'Girls! Girls! Girls!' While these movies were commercially successful, they had limited artistic value. On May 1, 1967, Elvis married Priscilla in Las Vegas, and their daughter Lisa Marie was born on February 9, 1968. During this period, Elvis's music production decreased as he focused primarily on his film career. However, the 1968 special 'Elvis' marked a significant turning point in his musical career, as he returned to the recording studio to create more substantial musical works.

points.title: 晚年回归
points.description: 1968年后，埃尔维斯回到孟菲斯，在位于格拉夫顿的录音室创作了更多有深度的音乐作品。1970年代，他开始了著名的拉斯维加斯驻场演出，成为赌城最受欢迎的表演者之一。然而，这一时期埃尔维斯也面临着健康问题，他开始依赖处方药物，体重增加，表演质量下降。1973年，他与普里西拉离婚。尽管如此，埃尔维斯仍然是美国文化的重要象征，他的演唱会门票总是售罄。1977年8月16日，埃尔维斯在孟菲斯的雅园家中去世，享年42岁，死因可能是心脏病发作，可能与药物滥用有关。他的去世标志着摇滚乐黄金时代的结束，但他的音乐遗产至今仍然影响着流行音乐。
points.descriptionEn: After 1968, Elvis returned to Memphis, creating more substantial music at American Sound Studio. In the 1970s, he began his famous Las Vegas residencies, becoming one of the city's most popular performers. However, this period was marked by health issues as Elvis became dependent on prescription drugs, gained weight, and the quality of his performances declined. In 1973, he divorced Priscilla. Despite these challenges, Elvis remained a significant cultural icon, with his concert tickets always selling out. On August 16, 1977, Elvis died at his Graceland home in Memphis at age 42, reportedly from a heart attack possibly related to drug abuse. His death marked the end of rock and roll's golden era, but his musical legacy continues to influence popular music today.

supporter.zh: 猫王被誉为摇滚乐之王，他彻底改变了流行音乐的面貌，将黑人音乐元素带入主流文化，打破了种族界限。他的表演风格充满活力和激情，影响了后世无数音乐人。埃尔维斯不仅是一位音乐家，更是文化现象，他代表了战后美国青年的反叛精神和自由追求。他的音乐跨越了种族和阶级，成为美国文化的重要组成部分。即使在晚年，他仍然保持着对音乐的热爱和对粉丝的尊重，这种真诚和热情使他成为永恒的偶像。
supporter.en: Elvis Presley, known as the King of Rock and Roll, revolutionized the face of popular music by bringing black musical elements into mainstream culture and breaking racial barriers. His energetic and passionate performance style influenced countless musicians who followed. Elvis was not just a musician but a cultural phenomenon, representing the rebellious spirit and pursuit of freedom of post-war American youth. His music transcended race and class, becoming an essential part of American culture. Even in his later years, he maintained his passion for music and respect for his fans, qualities that make him an eternal icon.

critic.zh: 批评者认为埃尔维斯的文化挪用行为值得争议，他成功地将黑人音乐商业化，而原创艺术家却很少获得同等认可和报酬。他的电影作品大多质量平庸，缺乏艺术深度，更多是商业投机而非艺术创作。此外，埃尔维斯晚年的健康状况和药物滥用问题也受到批评，一些人认为他的过早死亡是自我放纵的结果。他的表演风格也被批评为过于浮夸和商业化，缺乏真正的艺术创新。这些批评反映了流行文化中商业成功与艺术价值之间的永恒矛盾。
critic.en: Critics argue that Elvis's cultural appropriation is controversial, as he successfully commercialized black music while original artists rarely received equal recognition and compensation. His films were largely mediocre and lacked artistic depth, seen more as commercial ventures than artistic creations. Additionally, Elvis's declining health and drug abuse in later years have been criticized, with some viewing his premature death as a result of self-indulgence. His performance style has also been criticized as overly flamboyant and commercialized, lacking true artistic innovation. These criticisms reflect the eternal tension between commercial success and artistic value in popular culture.

objective.zh: 从历史和文化角度看，埃尔维斯·普雷斯利已成为20世纪美国文化最重要的象征之一。他代表了战后美国社会的变革，反映了种族融合和文化交融的时代特征。在流行音乐史上，他作为摇滚乐的先驱，将多种音乐形式融合创新，开创了新的音乐风格。尽管他的职业生涯经历了起伏，但他对流行音乐的影响是深远的。在流行文化中，埃尔维斯已成为一个超越音乐的文化符号，代表着青春、反叛和美国的梦想。他的遗产不仅体现在音乐作品中，更体现在他对后世艺术家和文化现象的持续影响上。
objective.en: From a historical and cultural perspective, Elvis Presley has become one of the most significant symbols of 20th-century American culture. He represented the transformation of post-war American society, reflecting the era's racial integration and cultural fusion. In the history of popular music, as a pioneer of rock and roll, he innovatively fused various musical forms, creating new styles. Despite the ups and downs of his career, his influence on popular music is profound. In popular culture, Elvis has transcended music to become a cultural symbol representing youth, rebellion, and the American dream. His legacy is not only evident in his musical works but also in his continuing influence on later artists and cultural phenomena.

self.zh: 摇滚乐就是生命，你知道我的意思吗？它就是一切。
self.en: Rock and roll is life, you know what I mean? It's everything.

others.zh: 他拥有上帝赐予的声音，但从未真正理解自己创造的文化革命。
others.en: He had a voice given by God, but never truly understood the cultural revolution he created.
